releaseNotes:
Hubble 1.3.0

Hubble 1.3.0: configurable long-press actions

Add 1-, 2-, and 3-second holds through action-column settings, Physical
Action Type, and the Advanced actions editor.

The Long Press column menu and duration badges make action timing easy
to see. Rotate Left and Rotate Right keep their existing behavior and
ignore column timing.

Companion runs native duration groups with short-tap handling, preserves
manual customizations, and synchronizes managed actions automatically.
Includes Companion module 0.3.5 and compatible support for older modules.
